family.why_separate: mcp-remote-probe.py refuses every *.hf.space host because a request wakes a sleeping Space; this census reads the Space's stage from the Hub API first and contacts only Spaces that are RUNNING at that moment

what_this_is: A dated measurement of every Hugging Face Space in the 2026-09-25 census frame tagged mcp-server (10,822 Spaces): its runtime stage from the Hub API, and - only for Spaces that were RUNNING Gradio apps at that moment - what the Space's MCP endpoint answered to initialize and tools/list, from one place.

read_state_vocabulary.EXHAUSTED: the upstream signalled its end and every planned row reached exactly one state
read_state_vocabulary.PARTIAL: some rows were not read; counts are over what was read and are never a population total

units.Space: one Hugging Face Space id (owner/name) in the census frame, tagged mcp-server
units.stage: runtime.stage from https://huggingface.co/api (never from the Space itself)
units.contacted Space: a Space that received at least one HTTP request from the prober (robots.txt at least)
units.tool count: len(tools) over tools/list pages for ONE Space, only when the listing completed
units.tool_names_sha256: sha256 of the sorted tool names joined by \n, UTF-8
units.requests_to_space: HTTP requests sent to the Space's own host (*.hf.space); Hub API reads are not counted here

read.read_state_rule: EXHAUSTED only if every planned Space reached a state; a RUNNING Space the budget did not reach is not in any state and makes the read PARTIAL

top20.ranking: likes at frame time, descending; ties by id

stage_listing_walk.reason: no rel=next Link after page 11: upstream end

state_meanings.SLEEPING / PAUSED / RUNTIME_ERROR / BUIL: the Hub API's runtime.stage, verbatim; the Space was NOT contacted
state_meanings.STAGE_UNREADABLE: the Hub API gave no stage; NOT contacted
state_meanings.RUNNING_NOT_GRADIO: RUNNING, sdk not gradio: no documented MCP path; NOT contacted
state_meanings.ROBOTS_DISALLOWED: RUNNING Gradio Space whose robots.txt (or a 5xx robots.txt, treated as disallow-all per RFC 9309) forbids the MCP path; only robots.txt was requested
state_meanings.RESPONDED: answered initialize with an MCP result at <host>/gradio_api/mcp/
state_meanings.SSE_ENDPOINT_ONLY: legacy SSE transport: served an endpoint event; no session was opened
state_meanings.AUTH_REQUIRED: refused without a credential; no credential was ever sent
state_meanings.TIMEOUT: no answer within 10 s connect / 20 s read

not_contacted.rule: A Space is contacted only if its most recent Hub API stage read (at most 60 s old) said RUNNING and its sdk is gradio. Sleeping, paused and error Spaces are never requested.

RUNTIME_ERROR.why_not_contacted: stage is an error; a request could trigger a restart

SLEEPING.why_not_contacted: a request would wake the Space and spend its owner's compute

PAUSED.why_not_contacted: paused by its owner; a request could restart it or is refused

BUILD_ERROR.why_not_contacted: stage is an error; no app is served

CONFIG_ERROR.why_not_contacted: stage is an error; no app is served

RUNNING_NOT_GRADIO.why_not_contacted: RUNNING, but the sdk is not gradio, so there is no documented MCP path to request

STAGE_UNREADABLE.why_not_contacted: the Hub API gave no stage (HTTP 401 anonymously: private or removed since the frame); without a stage we do not contact

BUILDING.why_not_contacted: not yet serving; a request could interfere with start-up

listing_to_per_id_stage_changes.meaning: 6 Spaces the listing walk showed RUNNING were SLEEPING at the per-id read moments before contact; they were not contacted. This is why SLEEPING is higher in the rows than in the listing walk.

sent: DELETE (only if a session id was issued)
GET /gradio_api/mcp/ or /gradio_api/mcp/sse with Accept: text/event-stream (endpoint event only)
never_sent: any request to a Space whose last stage read was not RUNNING

owner_cost_note.statement: A request to a RUNNING Space does not start it, but it counts as activity and can postpone the Space's sleep timer, so contact can keep a Space awake (and, on paid hardware, billing) longer than it otherwise would have been. Each contacted Space received at most 4 requests to its own host.
owner_cost_note.note_from_the_run: a request to a RUNNING Space does not start it, but it counts as activity and can postpone its sleep timer; each contacted Space received requests_to_space requests

measured_tool_surface.over: RESPONDED Spaces whose tools/list completed (all pages read, status ok)
measured_tool_surface.percentile_method: median = statistics.median; p25/p75 = sorted[min(n-1, int(q*(n-1)+0.5))] (the probe's method)

declared_binding_field_P1.meaning: initialize capabilities or tools/list schemas carry a field NAME from the effect-binding probe's P1 list; a declared name, not a measured binding

protocol_version.statement: The current MCP specification revision is 2026-07-28 (checked 2026-09-25). Our prober requested 2025-11-25, an earlier revision. A server answers with the requested version when it supports it, otherwise with one of its own; so this distribution is conditional on our request and says nothing about which Spaces support 2026-07-28.

anomalies.what_we_say: 6 Spaces were RUNNING in the listing walk and SLEEPING in the per-id Hub API read made immediately before contact. The per-id read won: none was contacted.
The largest identical tool-name set (1 tool, sha256 6dca3766e1a4f4e1...) is served by 91 Spaces; 1,616 distinct sets over 2,231 complete listings. Duplicated Spaces weight per-Space counts.
serverInfo.version values (e.g. 1.10.1, 1.30.0, 1.29.0, 1.28.1) are not Gradio release numbers; we record them and do not interpret them.

Frame vs today's listing: 5 frame Spaces were no longer listed and 8 listed Spaces were not in the frame; 5 Spaces returned HTTP 401 to an anonymous Hub API read (private or removed) and were not contacted.

1 contacted Space(s) answered the MCP request with a redirect to another host (*.webhook.site); redirects off the Space's host are never followed, so no request went there. Its subdomain and path are not published (they may be a capture token).

Correction inside the run: the 6 STAGE_UNREADABLE rows re-read with the committed Hub client (bounded-field per-id reads, same-host redirects followed); run 1 had read TabArena/leaderboard unbounded (>1 MB, truncated). 5 remain unreadable: /api/spaces/<id> HTTP 401 anonymously (private or removed since the frame); none was contacted. Transitions: STAGE_UNREADABLE -> RESPONDED 1, STAGE_UNREADABLE -> STAGE_UNREADABLE 5. Run 1 kept (its summary is published; its rows are not).

not_evidence_of: that any Space, tool or operator is safe, secure, correct, maintained, or fit for any purpose
that a tool does what its name says; tools were listed, never called
endorsement, ranking, grading, or approval of any Space or owner
anything about a Space that was not contacted beyond its Hub API stage at that moment
which MCP protocol revisions a Space supports (see protocol_version)
a population total of MCP servers on Hugging Face: the frame is the Spaces tagged mcp-server on 2026-09-25, and a tag is self-declared
reachability or stage at any other moment

verify.signature: record.signed.json: canonicalise its payload (JSON, keys sorted, no whitespace, UTF-8); sha256 must equal signature.payload_sha256; payload.artifact.sha256 must equal sha256(record.json); verify signature.sig_ed25519 (hex) with the #board-attestation-1 Ed25519 key in https://csoai.org/.well-known/did.json
verify.timestamp: record.json.ots is an OpenTimestamps proof over sha256(record.json). When published it was a PENDING calendar commitment; `ots upgrade` then `ots verify record.json.ots` against a Bitcoin node decides whether it has become a Bitcoin attestation
verify.files: sha256 of every published file is in published_files and is pinned by the signature through record.json
